question: Two identical solid hemispheres, each with a radius of 21 cm, are melted and recast into a single sphere. What is the radius of the new sphere formed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Two identical solid hemispheres perfectly combine to form exactly one full solid sphere of the same radius.

Therefore, the volume and dimensions match perfectly without any relative change in the radius.

Radius of the new sphere = Radius of the given hemisphere = 21 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of each hemisphere (R) = 21 cm

Number of identical hemispheres melted = 2
